fieldValues.title: Where should the record of a protocol run live?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Raised by srs-rust#1711 (Research: Minutes with provenance, part 4). No option chosen.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. ProtocolRun becomes a spec entity with a place in the repository layout, carried in archives and slices.
- B. Process-step records in the document, as the prototype does: ordinary records, already portable.
- C. Both: the run for live state, records for history.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Whether anyone needs to continue a half-finished run after a hand-over; whether process steps as records clutter the document.
fieldValues.next_action: Decide with the fix for srs-rust#1711.
